construction_highlights: Integrated titanium interface for a play-free fit and ultra-precise power transfer
Pressed into the front wing during lamination for a permanent, ultra-stiff bond in the system's most highly loaded area
All main connection threads are located in titanium for reduced wear, easier maintenance, and long-term durability
Corrosion-resistant construction for reliable use in saltwater environments
One-tool system: all key connections on the hydrofoil setup and board use the same T30 Torx tool
free_series_front_wings.included: Cover, 2 x M6x20 glider connection screws and TX30 tool

fw-540.headline: Built for extremely high top-end performance, agile handling, and precise control.
fw-540.description: The FW 540 is the smallest front wing in the Free Series, optimized for riders who want maximum top-end performance with agile and easy control. With a 67 cm span, 540 cm² area, and 8.4 aspect ratio, it is positioned for kite, wing, and big wave surf use.
product_features: Free Series-specific outline and anhedral geometry for agility and balance
Lift-to-drag ratio optimized for its specific application
Designed for kite, wing, and big wave surf use

fw-680.headline: Built for high top-end performance, balanced agility, and precise control.
fw-680.description: The FW 680 is designed for riders who want strong speed potential with a more balanced mix of glide, control, and agility. Positioned between the smaller, more radical sizes and the larger freeride-oriented wings, it delivers an efficient, precise ride feel across multiple disciplines.
product_features: Free Series-specific outline and anhedral geometry for agility and balance
Lift-to-drag ratio optimized for its specific application
Tuned for efficient speed, control, and versatile use

fw-790.headline: Built for efficient glide, balanced control, and versatile freeride performance.
fw-790.description: The FW 790 is designed for riders who want a balanced mix of early lift, smooth glide, and precise control. Positioned deeper in the freeride range, it offers a more accessible and versatile ride feel while maintaining the speed efficiency and clean handling that define the Free Series.
product_features: Free Series-specific outline and anhedral geometry for balanced handling
Lift-to-drag ratio optimized for smooth glide and controlled freeride performance
Tuned for versatile use across a wide range of conditions

fw-900.headline: Built for early lift, smooth glide, and balanced freeride performance.
fw-900.description: The FW 900 is designed for riders who want an efficient freeride wing with easy lift, clean glide, and a stable, confidence-inspiring ride feel. It sits in the sweet spot for versatile freeride use, combining accessible handling with the efficient performance and precise control that define the Free Series.
product_features: Free Series-specific outline and anhedral geometry for balanced handling
Lift-to-drag ratio optimized for smooth glide and efficient freeride use
Tuned for versatile performance across a wide range of conditions

boom_scc_boards.tagline: Built for maximum flow, early lift, and efficient glide across wing, parawing, and downwind sessions.
boom_scc_boards.intro: Sometimes you do not need three boards for three conditions. You need one that gets you on foil more often. Boom SCC Boards fill exactly that gap with efficient mid-length shapes for glide, stability, and early lift-off, combined with an ultra-light, stiff hollow construction feel. Built for wing, parawing, and downwind use, they are designed to release cleanly, stay calm in the air, and keep the ride efficient without feeling sluggish.
boom_scc_boards.description: Boom SCC Boards are the mid-length hollow-construction boards of the Free Series, built for riders who want earlier lift, more glide, and a calm, efficient ride without giving up agility. Positioned between a classic wing board and a pure downwind shape, they combine enough length for efficiency, enough balance for control, and enough responsiveness to keep turns, transitions, and maneuvers lively and fun.
construction_highlights: Hollow SCC construction for an ultra-light, extremely stiff shell feel
Reinforced US mast track area for uncompromising power transfer under load
Low swing weight for easier handling in turns, transitions, and quick corrections
Clean energy transfer for more efficient pumping
Narrow nose and tail with a far-forward mast position to reduce perceived inertia
boom_scc_boards.scope_of_delivery: Straps, Foil-to-Board Mounting Hardware & Premium Boardbag
